conviction_note: The release is almost fully pre-released: the FP27/2 DPU was revised up to 4,282 yen on 2026-09-18 together with the disposals and a 10bn yen buyback, and the 9/18 deck already showed that gains will be distributed through FP27/8 and FP28/2. What is left is FP26/8 against a 4,040 yen guide this issuer usually beats, and a first FP27/8 guide whose shape is already public. Three small positive findings sum to +0.40. The scaled number is +0.11 (p_up 54 x abs 1.4) because the REIT tape is weak today (index -1.0%), margin longs are crowded (信用倍率 26) and the name's own print reactions are small (+0.58, +2.33 with a new buyback, -0.84).

findings.finding: FP26/8 DPU is guided at 4,040 yen, and the issuer has a run of upward revisions and beats on this line: the FP26/8 guide went 3,464 (2025-10-21) -> 3,972 (2026-02-26) -> 4,040 (2026-04-22), and FP26/2 printed 3,725 against an initial 3,552. The period ended with 1,659,112 units, about 1,100 below the count implied by the guide (6,279m / 3,782 yen), so a small beat is the base case; this lands inside guidance.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Previous results prints (released 15:30): 2025-04 next session +0.58%; 2025-10-21 -> 10-22 +2.33% (REIT index +0.8%), but that print came with a new buyback; 2026-04-22 -> 04-23 -0.84% (index -0.17%). Yahoo daily bars, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3466.T?range=2y&interval=1d
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. A J-REIT period ending inside a guide revised three times leaves little to surprise. The only unpriced part is the size of the beat, and the pattern of upward revisions is public.
findings.independence: Separate document: the 2026-02-26 upward revision (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260226/140120260220566820.pdf) and the 2025-10-21 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251021/140120251021576446.pdf), which give the revision history. The unit count is from the 2026-10-01 buyback status notice.

findings.finding: Tonight's release will carry the first FP27/8 forecast. The 2026-09-18 deck says gains totalling 5.6bn yen will be 'fully distributed' over FP27/2, FP27/8 and FP28/2, and the LP Sakai Minamijimacho leg of the 18.5bn yen bulk sale (3.5bn gain) closes in May 2027 (FP27/8), with 7.7bn yen of proceeds in that period. So the new guide should carry a gain-supported DPU rather than fall back to the roughly 2,950-yen ex-gain base, plus buyback accretion.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A new period forecast arrives at every print. The one comparable guide shock, the 2026-09-18 package (disposals, FP27/2 DPU +33%, 10bn yen buyback), moved the stock +5.33% on 2026-09-24 against an index down 0.11%. Tonight's guide is the follow-through to that package, not a new one.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly. The deck shows the gains run through FP28/2 and when the proceeds settle, but it puts no number on FP27/8 DPU, and no consensus is reachable here. If the market had fully priced a gain-supported FP27/8, the stock would not have given back the whole 9/24 pop. Most of that give-back matches the REIT index, though, so this is weak.
findings.independence: Same transaction set as the English deck (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260918/140120260918538617.pdf) and the FP27/2 revision notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260918/140120260918538378.pdf). One document family, counted once.

findings.finding: The 6th buyback (up to 10bn yen / 71,500 units, priced at 0.9x NAV, running to Sep 2027) bought 16,379 units for 2.37bn yen in its first five sessions (9/24 to 9/30), about 23% of the program in a week, so steady buying continues through the window at prices below the September average (about 144,500 yen) and at a sub-NAV multiple.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Buyback announcements: +2.33% at the 2025-10-21 print (buyback announced with results), and +5.33% on 2026-09-24 (with the disposals). Monthly status notices (10/01) moved the stock +1.11% (index -0.43%).
findings.why_not_priced: The program is public. What may not be priced is the execution pace: a buyer of this size in a stock turning over about 1bn yen a day supports the post-release session. If it were fully priced, the stock would not be trading at its 9/18 pre-announcement level.
findings.independence: Program terms in https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260918/140120260918538486.pdf (the same program, so not independent).

outside_window.finding: The October buyback status (units and yen bought in October) will be disclosed in the monthly status notice in early November.
Gain realisation on LP Sakai Minamijimacho (May 2027) and LP Sakai Chikko Shinmachi (Sep 2027) depends on the staggered closings.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive while the baseline lean is -0.6 (crowded margin longs) and the REIT index is falling into the print. The strongest positive the release could carry is an FP27/8 guide well above the ex-gain base plus another FP27/2 bump from buyback accretion. I looked for it and it is largely telegraphed by the 9/18 deck, so the scaled number sits well under the findings sum.
